data: Culture, Cognition, and Subjectivity:  Psychological Worlds Across Contexts

Comprehension of cultural factors is a key to critical inquiry onto all major branches of
 psychology such as cognitive, developmental, social, and clinical. Moving across
 mainstream, critical, and non-Western approaches — with a focus on South Asian
 contexts,this course explores how human subjectivity and cognition are embedded in
 and are shaped by culture, history, and social worlds. We will examine how
 psychological processes are mediated through language, embodiment, ritual, narrative,
 and social structures like caste, gender, and coloniality.
